messages:
Taylor: dropped a fresh Figma frame for the API Keys page. main concerns: revoke discoverability, rotate copy length, and an onboarding hint for empty state. can people skim?

Mina (PM): main ask from support: users miss revoke in the kebab. prefer a small "Danger" panel at bottom with a red primary revoke and secondary rotate.

Evan (Design): agree. Also trimmed rotate modal: lead sentence + single-line note. proposal: 'New key generated — copy now. This value is shown only once.' and a small row of scope pills.

Jordan (A11y): accessibility notes: ensure "shown only once" is available to screen readers via visually-hidden text. copy button needs aria-describedby pointing to that text. modal must focus the title and trap focus.

Taylor: regarding overlap/gentle rollout: product wants an opt-in checkbox. wording idea: 'Enable 30-minute overlap (lets old key keep working while you roll out)'. default off.

Mina (PM): UI should show both a countdown and absolute end time on details if overlap enabled. support asked for an org-level banner if any key has overlap active.

Jordan (A11y): countdown must not be the only cue. include icon + static end time text like 'Overlap ends at 14:12 UTC' and aria-live="polite" for updates. tooltips need role="tooltip" and keyboard dismiss.

Evan (Design): empty state: keep primary CTA 'Create API key' and a small secondary 'Use a template' link that opens 3 compact templates (client read-only, server full, embed limited). templates as microcards.

Mina (PM): copy for revoke modal: headline 'Permanently revoke key' + subcopy 'This will immediately stop any clients using the key.' Require a checkbox 'I understand this will stop traffic' before enabling revoke.

Jordan (A11y): confirm checkbox must announce state changes; when revoke completes, toast should be role=alert. Also avoid relying on color alone for danger states.

Taylor: small developer nicety: show scopes inline on create success (2-line max) and add 'View full settings' link. avoid cluttering the copy area.

Evan (Design): action items: add danger panel in frame, tighten rotate language, add template panel for empty state.

Mina (PM): I'll post final copy variants here for sign-off.

ci-bot: Staging deploy scheduled 2026-03-24T17:00Z — includes keys UI styling updates.

Taylor: thanks all — will iterate and request a11y pass once frames are updated. :thumbsup:
